title: Wire colour abbreviations and cable colour sequences
notes: Two-letter codes follow IEC 60757. Multi-colour wires concatenate codes (GNYE = green/yellow).
render_hex values are screen colours for diagrams only; they are not part of any standard.

codes.source: IEC 60757 (letter codes for colours); cross-checked 2026-11-10 against https://github.com/wireviz/WireViz/blob/master/src/wireviz/wv_colors.py

DIN.source: DIN 47100 (colour code for telecommunication cable cores); sequence cross-checked 2026-11-10 against https://github.com/wireviz/WireViz/blob/master/src/wireviz/wv_colors.py

IEC.source: IEC 60757 colour order as used for the resistor colour code (IEC 60062); cross-checked 2026-11-10 against https://github.com/wireviz/WireViz/blob/master/src/wireviz/wv_colors.py

T568A.source: ANSI/TIA-568 pin/pair assignment T568A; cross-checked 2026-11-10 against https://github.com/wireviz/WireViz/blob/master/src/wireviz/wv_colors.py

T568B.source: ANSI/TIA-568 pin/pair assignment T568B; cross-checked 2026-11-10 against https://github.com/wireviz/WireViz/blob/master/src/wireviz/wv_colors.py
